title: Account Provisioning Process
description: Assessment questions for the IDNT-03 account provisioning test case. Each question maps to one or more how-to guides that describe specific test techniques.

questions.text: Is there any authorisation required before an account is provisioned?
Can accounts be provisioned with excessive privileges?

applicable_how_tos.name: Attempt to assign admin role via API

questions.text: Can one user provision an account for another user without oversight?

applicable_how_tos.name: Test separation of duties in provisioning

questions.text: Are provisioned accounts tied to a verified identity?

applicable_how_tos.name: Test identity verification bypass during provisioning
Provision account for non-existent or unverified identity

questions.text: Is the provisioning process logged and auditable?

applicable_how_tos.name: Check log retention and tamper protection

questions.text: Is there a de-provisioning (offboarding) process, and is it enforced?

applicable_how_tos.name: Verify de-provisioning trigger on HR event

questions.text: Are provisioning requests validated before execution?

applicable_how_tos.name: Test parameter tampering on provisioning API
Test mass assignment in provisioning endpoint
